tei:div.tei:p: de yang rdzogs pa chen po tshig don bcu gcig pa 'di ni zhang mkhas pa chen po nyi 'bum gyis ljags rtsom gnang ba zhig ste/ 'di'i ma dpe ni sngar 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin par grags shing*/ da lta dpe dngos ni khams dpal spungs dgon pa'i dpe mdzod nang du bzhugs yod/ spyi lo 2002lor gzan dkar rin po che'i bka' bzhin/ dpal spungs dgon pa'i dpe rnying rnams srung skyobs dang 'brel dkar chag 'bri skabs nga tshor bu dpe zhig g.yar rgyu byung*/ 'on kyang ma dpe dngos la khams bris tshugs chung klog bde zhing mi gsal ba sogs med rung*/ nang don sa bcad dang*/ tshigs 'bru 'ga' shas chad 'dug pas kha bskong ma thub pa rnams la gug rtags stong pa zhig bzhag yod/ yang tha snyad 'ga' shas ni go shin tu dka' bas ming tshig dag po rang e yod na snyams pa byung yang*/ ma dpe sor bzhags kyis zhu dag byas cing*/ yi ge dag cha nor nges rnams ni deng dus yongs grags kyi brda sprod dang bstun nas bcos/ ma dpe dngos kyang da lam par skrun byed skabs lhan du bzhags nas rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/ 'byung char mkhyen ldan klog pa po rnams kyis 'di las dpe gzhan pa rnyed son byung na dag bcos gnang rgyu thugs bzhag yod pa mkhyen/ mkhyen/ da lam nga tsho'i mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di spyi tshogs thog 'grel spel byed skabs/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis mnyam las kyi sgo nas/ zhu dag dang*/ 'char 'god sogs rogs ram rgya chen gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba dang bcas/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/ 2008 lo'i zla 6 tshes 10 nyin la/ bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 3--PAGE 1-
